discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B005 (packet 205). 30 standard searches. Main source: dein-dlrp.de monthly pages (Feb-Apr, Jun-Sep, Nov-Dec 2019; Jan, May, Oct not indexed), translated from German. Pin Trader Club for Oct/Dec. All search snippets/summaries only. Carrousel and World's Best Friends 2019 pins sit in several set keys (Feb Jaq&Gus, Nov Mulan/Buzz&Woody) - consider series grouping. Lion King jumbo July 2019 confirmed.
